panels.scene_description: Haru stares out the classroom window, barely paying attention to the teacher's lecture, while Nozomi leans forward, tapping her pencil in contemplation.
The lone figure stands alone in the dimly lit alleyway, her eyes fixed on someone or something far away, as if searching for a glimpse of recognition.
The teacher stands in front of the class, her stern gaze fixed on the student who has been struggling with their work.

dialogue.speaker: Nozomi
dialogue.text: You're going to fail the exam if you keep doing that,

panels.scene_description: Haru, a teenage boy with short messy black hair and a downcast expression, turns around slowly as he prepares to speak to someone.
The quiet, contemplative figure in the background looks deeply engaged with his notebook, as if lost in thought or contemplating something important.

dialogue.speaker: Haru
dialogue.text: I don't really care about the exam,

panels.scene_description: Nozomi, known as the "Teenage Ninja" in the story, is seated at a desk, flipping through her notebook while paying close attention to her friend's actions.
